extra.reason: Decided: Gateway profile owns display name, email aliases, role and the Discord channel link. Plugin card (keyed by profileId) owns family role, nicknames, phone, device MACs, calendars, reminder prefs, plus a Discord ID stub collected during setup and checked against the core link. Stub also resolves 'me/my' for tools until the upstream SDK bead lands.
Operator handles the family bot handoff himself; other installs have no second bot, so the plugin needs no handoff switch.
Decided: Discord works in every mode; Control UI per household access mode; operator's household uses LAN mode with Caddy basic_auth per-person logins (s5k.32.3, spike s5k.32.4).
